summary: Marks the backend Schedule3D package and stores its version number, 0.2.1.
purpose: Gives the backend package a short description and one version value that other code can read.
why: Likely reason: a single place for the version number, so the API reports the same version everywhere it reads it.
how: When any code imports the schedule3d package, Python runs this file first. It sets the description and the version value named `__version__`.
inputs: None. The file takes no input.
outputs: The `__version__` value, currently 0.2.1, which the API uses in its health check and its title.
risks: Changing the version here changes what the health check reports to anyone who calls it.
debug: If the wrong version appears in the app, check this file first. If importing the package fails, check that the backend folder is on the Python path.
